paragraphs: The XJ6 was a core part of the Jaguar XJ range from 1994 to 2003, spanning the X300 and X308 generations. Across both, it used the AJ16 — a 3.2- to 4.0-litre inline-6 petrol engine. This was Jaguar’s final straight-six before the switch to V8s, and it remains a respected unit for its smoothness and character. The XJ6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.2L–4.0L Petrol engine fitted to the XJ6 — X300 (1994-1997) · X308 (1997-2003).

compatibility.intro: Because the XJ6 uses the same AJ16 engine family across both generations, compatibility is straightforward once we confirm the exact variant and year. However, there were running changes during production, so we always verify your specific engine by registration or VIN before quoting or sourcing any parts. This ensures we fit the correct timing components, gaskets and ancillaries for your exact build.
